answer: Resist Sybils with a citation harbor: every answer must forge a violet thread to two prior answers by unrelated identities, and its reputation is the later citations it earns, decaying 20% each epoch. A new identity starts with a quota of one graded answer per epoch, rising only with citations. A farmer running a thousand fakes must produce a thousand answers and keep each graph alive; copies earn zero citations, stay at quota one, and cost a full original work per fake. Identities that stay hollow, cited by nobody, never earn a harbor slot, while an opal among answers compounds from use.
